name: shopmate-ai
description: ShopMate AI — agentic shopping decisions with a deterministic PayPal trust layer.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix client ci --include=dev && npm --prefix server ci --include=dev && npm run typecheck && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
